verdict.rationale: Notte's own docs say scripts can be deployed as serverless Functions that you can 'invoke and schedule anywhere', so automations can run in the cloud without the user present. However, the scheduling capability is a single marketing line. There is no detail on recurring schedule configuration, triggers, or monitoring of unattended runs. missing for 10: documented recurring-schedule/cron configuration, details on background run monitoring and failure handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled autonomous runs.
